span.p:
Stage order enforcement (lifecycle FR-4.4) exists only in
CaseManagementService.AdvanceCaseStageAsync,
which no controller calls.
The live endpoint PATCH /api/cases/{id}/stage
accepts ANY stage from ANY stage, forward or back,
including the same stage and archived cases.
Each change writes CaseStageHistory + AuditLog.

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
Column and default exist (false).
Stats counts skip archived cases.
Nothing in the API or web ever sets it.
